My Belief.

“How have you seen a culture change in the last year — and do you believe it’s redeemable, able to strengthen and grow?”

Closing

Twenty years ago, this company started in an empty warehouse with twelve people and one decision — to do things right.

Every crisis, every acquisition, every year of growth since then came down to protecting that decision.

I’m asking this room to help me protect it for the next twenty.

Thank You.
